events.title: Demo Update 1.0
events.summary: The Ever After Again demo has been updated This patch cleans up combat — no more swings passing through enemies on stairs, after the grappling hook, or in Berserker — restores the missing Japanese, Chinese and Korean characters in the book, rebalances the Book of Destinies mix so the narrator sits above the music, and adds inverted Y-axis. Patch notes Fixed bugs with voice lines Fixed a facial animation bug for Zenobia Fixed a bug where the Cutlass can pass through enemies and miss when fighting

events.title: The People of Boreas
events.summary: In case you haven't played it (yet), Stories: The Path of Destinies is a tongue-in-cheek self-aware epic hero’s journey, with Reynardo the sly fox, an evil emperor named Isengrim, his daughter the fabulous princess Zenobia, and a tricksy rabbit Lapino.For Ever After Again: A Stories Adventure, we wanted to take the storytelling a little farther.
